intro.title: Red Coral (Japan)
intro.descriptionHtml: Japanese red coral, scientifically known as Corallium Japonicum, is a valuable and culturally significant coral species found in Japan's surrounding waters. This deep-sea coral has been treasured for centuries for its stunning orangish-red coloration and unique growth patterns, and it has been used in traditional jewelry and ornamental pieces, as well as religious and ceremonial artifacts. It provides the wearer with protection, strength, and positive energy in a variety of spiritual and healing practices.

tabs.tab1_description:
The Japanese Red Coral gemstone has fascinated mankind since ancient ages. It was used as an amulet to ward off the evil eye, to stop bleeding, to ward away evil spirits, to ward off nightmares, to facilitate teeth coming out in babies and even to calm storms. Coral, the name comes from the Greek word ‘korallion’ meaning 'hard skeleton'. Japanese Red Coral has remained popular throughout ages due to its mystic and spiritual properties and benefits. Jewelry made from Red Coral was a favorite amongst the rich as it was a means to exhibit their wealth. 

Red coral grows from the skeletons of coral polyps, animals no larger than one millimeter. Their skeletons, made of calcium carbonate, pile up to form coral. It takes more than 100,000 years for coral to turn into a reef. Unlike other gemstones which are found on Earth crust, this gemstone is found naturally in the dark parts of deep Sea.

The Japanese Red Coral gemstone consists of thornless bushes with intertwined calcium carbonate needles. Polyps are gelatinous marine organisms that have the appearance of colorful aquatic plants. Red Corals are organic, natural gemstones composed of the deposited skeletons of individual Polyps. Red Coral characteristics include its toughness, durability, and intense red, orange or pink color.

Japanese coral is predominantly composed of aragonite. Differences in composition affect the color and quality of red coral. Typically, Japanese coral is light orange or red. The variance in color is due to the chemical composition of coral. Red Coral from Japan is rarer than red coral from Italy. The Pacific Ocean is home to Japanese coral, while the Mediterranean Sea is home to Italian coral. Consequently, it is more difficult to harvest Japanese coral, which increases its value.

In Vedic Astrology, Japanese Red Coral is associated with the Planet Mars or Mangal Graha in Hindi. It is believed to bless the wearer with physical and mental strength. Red Coral Japan gemstone also provides protection against enemies, evil eye, spells and curses and all sought negativities. The Japanese Red Coral stone is a matte in its natural form but can be polished to a glossy shine and is used widely in making Jewelry. The gemstone measures 3.5 on the Mohs scale. 

Japanese Red Coral brings immense peace and helps people who are stuck in bad memories to get rid of them and move on. It makes you feel calm and creates a relaxing atmosphere that reminds you of the sea, where it comes from. It has healing powers especially for women and children. It is thought to help with circulatory and nervous system problems, blood problems, and strengthening the skeleton.

Red Coral Japan gemstone activates an underactive root chakra which will make you feel more physically secure and stable. Your newfound stability will allow you to face your fears with ease; they will no longer be able to prevent you from pursuing your dreams.

Japanese Red Coral's captivating orangish-red hue and inherent beauty make it a sought-after gemstone for exquisite jewelry, representing love, ardor, and vitality. In spiritual and healing practices, it is thought to provide the wearer with protection, inner strength, and positive energy.

Important Details:

Japanese Red Coral Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Japanese red coral is primarily found in deep-sea waters surrounding Japan, particularly in the Sea of Japan, the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Kyushu, and the Ogasawara Islands. These areas provide ideal conditions for the growth of this valuable coral species, which thrives at depths ranging from 200 to 1,000 meters.

Observe their Color:

Japanese red coral has a striking and intense red color that ranges from deep crimson to vibrant pink. Japanese red coral's bright, light and vivid orangish-red hues are frequently associated with themes of passion, love, and vitality, making it a highly symbolic and culturally significant gemstone in Japan and beyond.

Notice their Clarity:

The clarity of this coral gemstone may impact its overall value, with pieces that are transparent and devoid of visible flaws commanding higher market prices. Nevertheless, some collectors and enthusiasts value the unique characteristics and flaws of coral, viewing them as part of the gem's natural beauty and authenticity, which increases its desirability as an ornamental and spiritual stone.

Examine their Inclusions:

Inclusions can vary in nature and size, from tiny mineral particles to small cracks or voids. Some collectors and jewelers prefer Japanese red coral with minimal inclusions for its pristine appearance, while others appreciate inclusions for adding character and uniqueness to the gemstone, enhancing its organic beauty. Inclusions in Japanese red coral show its natural origin and connection to its marine habitat and shaping processes over time.

See their Shape:

Commonly Japanese Red Coral is cut in Oval or Capsule-shape for use in Red Coral stone Rings. Look for a regular shape and even surface.

Check the Carats:

For Red Coral of gem quality, the raw Red Coral is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Red Coral weighing between 7 and 15 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Red Coral is sold by weight, Red Coral prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Red Coral has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Japanese Red Coral

Due to treatments the Red Coral stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Red Coral do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate 

It is recommended that you should purchase Red Coral gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Red Coral are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Japanese Red Coral from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Japanese Red Coral gemstone to someone else? 

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Red Coral gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Red Coral is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).  

Color 

The best quality Japanese Red Coral are light and bright orangish-red to pink in color and have a smooth, lustrous and spotless surface. 

Cut 

Best quality Japanese Red Coral have cuts that maximize the effect of color play, hue, tone, saturation and surface area, such as capsule-shapes and oval cuts.

Carat 

The Japanese Red Coral of 7 – 15 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Red Coral Japan Stones are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Red Coral rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity 

Japanese red coral gemstones are brilliant, flawless, and devoid of cracks and blemishes; consequently, their clarity is outstanding.

Dealers deal in Japanese Red Coral which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Japanese Red Coral gemstone Price  

Japanese coral price is considerably more expensive than Italian red coral due to its rarity. Depending on the size, color, and quality of the gemstone, the price can vary, but in general, Japanese coral can be up to ten times more expensive than Italian coral. Japan red coral has a unique pale red color and bright orange hues which makes of it one of the most valuable and vivid colored gemstones.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Red Coral has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Red Coral stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Japanese Red Coral gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 7,080 to INR 1,18,150 (USD 87 to USD 1.453).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Japanese Red Coral?

The best way to check the authenticity of Japanese Red Coral is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Red Coral are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Red Coral carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Red Coral is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Red Coral have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Red Coral, but if you find flaws, then your Red Coral is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Red Coral are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Red Coral. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Red Coral, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Red Coral from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Japanese Red Coral. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Red Coral. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Japanese Red Coral Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well. 

Clean natural Japanese Red Coral gemstone with a soft polishing cloth and plain water. Rinse with a mild solution of soap and water. Do not soak. Avoid sudden temperature changes.

Avoid using commercial jewelry cleaners as they can damage the gemstone.
